title: 霸王龙的牙齿 · 素材
subtitle: 给对比页用的单体素材，不是一本书
style: children's picture book illustration, soft watercolour washes with fine pencil outlines and visible paper grain, warm earth tones with deep teal and rust orange

pages.scene: One single fossil tooth standing upright with its sharp point at the top, seen from the side: a smooth solid cone of pale cream bone, thick and rounded at the base and narrowing steadily to the point, leaning very slightly to one side, its surface smooth and plain all over. Centred and filling most of the picture on a flat cream background of one single even colour.
One single ripe banana seen from the side, clearly curved, its stem at the top, centred and filling most of the picture on a flat cream background of one single even colour.

One single bread knife lying horizontally, the long straight blade with a row of saw teeth along its lower edge and a plain handle at the right end, centred and filling most of the picture on a flat cream background of one single even colour.

One single large meat-eating dinosaur standing on two legs, seen from the side and facing left, its whole body from snout to tail tip inside the picture, its two small front arms visible against its chest, centred on a flat cream background of one single even colour.
One single cut-away jaw bone seen from the side, a thick horizontal bar of bone with two rounded sockets opening along its top edge, centred on a flat cream background of one single even colour.
